title: Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong programming skills in Python or Java. The candidate should understand data structures, algorithms, SQL, REST APIs and Git. Experience with software development projects is preferred.

title: Python Developer
description: Looking for a Python Developer with knowledge of Python, Flask or Django, REST APIs and SQL. Knowledge of machine learning and Git is an advantage.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Frontend Developer required with strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Experience with React, responsive web design and Git is preferred.

title: Data Analyst
description: We are looking for a Data Analyst who can work with Python, SQL, Pandas and NumPy. Knowledge of Excel, Power BI and data visualization is required.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Full Stack Developer responsible for developing modern web applications using React and Node.js. Knowledge of MongoDB, REST APIs, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Git is required.
